parole.significato: A German semiautomatic pistol used by their troops in both World Wars.
parole.testo: From the German surname, from Lugau in Saxony, a placename of Slavic origin.

parole.significato: A European freshwater fish in the family Percidae, closely related to the perch, Sander lucioperca.
parole.testo: Borrowed from German Zander, from a Slavic language, perhaps via Middle Low German sandāt. Pfeifer states that the first German attestation is East Central German czandas (in the Marienburger Treßlerbuch) circa 1400, which he derives from Pomeranian *sądač (compare Slovincian sãdzoc), from Proto-Sla

parole.significato: A fish of species Ballerus ballerus (syn. Abramis ballerus) native to Eurasia.
parole.testo: Unadapted borrowing from dialectal German Zope (French sope), probably from Slavic (compare Russian сапа́ (sapá)).
